decision_framework.title: Multi-Tier Testing Strategy Framework
decision_framework.context: Determining the testing depth, isolation boundary, and test double approach for a specific software component.

branch.condition: Pure algorithmic calculations, data transformations, chunking logic, and business rules without external I/O
branch.recommendation: Isolated Unit Tests (AAA Pattern) with Zero Doubles
branch.trade_offs: Executes in microseconds, 100% deterministic, indestructible; trade-off: does not verify database connectivity.
branch.anti_pattern: Never introduce Mocks or Stubs when testing pure functions.

branch.condition: Services interacting with repositories, database queries, and data access layers
branch.recommendation: In-Memory Fake Repository for unit tests + Transaction Rollback Integration Tests for real queries
branch.trade_offs: Unit tests remain sub-millisecond fast using Fakes; integration tests verify SQL syntax against real PostgreSQL; trade-off: requires maintaining an in-memory fake implementation.
branch.anti_pattern: Never mock database client methods like prisma.user.findFirst directly.

branch.condition: Critical end-to-end user journeys (authentication login, document upload and vector search)
branch.recommendation: Playwright E2E Tests with Page Object Model (POM)
branch.trade_offs: Validates full browser stack, CSS layout, and network integration; trade-off: slower execution, requires test database seeding.
branch.anti_pattern: Do not write E2E tests for visual edge cases that can be verified via unit tests.
